summary: Brunswick County, NC: a 100-foot Aermotor tower of 1929; staffing was discontinued in 2005; no source describes the site today.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: 100-foot Aermotor LS-40 steel tower erected about four miles south of Bolivia
CCC camp P-62 completed a 30 x 36 foot five-room dwelling at the lookout site
Coast and Geodetic Survey station described; tower about 110 feet high with an enclosed metal cab at the top
Survey station recovered by US Power Squadron, in good condition
Staffing of the tower discontinued, November 2005

notes_for_editor: Height disagrees: the state reports give 100 feet (30.5 m), while the 1942 federal survey description says about 110 feet; the sources do not explain the gap, so the story reports both. No source gives the condition after the 2001 survey recovery, and none describes the site today. The 2005 WECT report covers all four Brunswick County towers but does not name Bolivia, so it is not tied to this tower. A DigitalNC photo record (Bolivia Tower LS-40 100ft Aermotor, dated 1929-11) appeared in search but could not be read, so no photo is added; check its licence before using it. Access is unknown.
